prayerExcerpt.en-US: And the lot fell upon Matthias.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: E a sorte caiu sobre Matias.

meta.face: An old man around 70, a full thick head of wavy white hair, a neat rounded white beard, gentle steady expression.
meta.basis: Old man with a rounded beard (Painter's Manual); full hair to set him apart from Simon.

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
